purpose: The callout (admonition) type sets, the machine-readable companion to references/formatting.md: GitHub's five alerts, the only types the vault uses (AGENTS.md, Conventions), and the complete Obsidian set with aliases, for a target that renders it. Each entry is one rendered style; the listed types are interchangeable aliases for it. Type matching is case-insensitive. The render syntax is `> [!type]`, with `-` for collapsed-by-default, `+` for expanded-but-foldable, and trailing text as a custom title.

syntax.body: arbitrary markdown on subsequent `>` lines (lists, code, tables, nested callouts)

callouts.use: a failed check or a gap

github_alert_subset.note: The vault's set, and the only types GitHub renders: UPPERCASE, the marker alone on its line, a title as a bold lead-in on the first body line. Everything else degrades to a plain blockquote.
github_alert_subset.limit: one or two per document; do not nest
